tickets.subject: User cannot sign in after password reset
tickets.customer_issue: Verify email and reset status; confirm browser and SSO configuration.
tickets.next_action: Ask user to retry reset link, check expiry, and capture timestamp if it persists.

tickets.subject: Imported candidates do not appear in search
tickets.customer_issue: Confirm import completion, filters, and candidate visibility permissions.
tickets.next_action: Check import result, clear filters, confirm workspace and access scope.

tickets.subject: CSV import reports invalid columns
tickets.customer_issue: Compare file headers and required fields against import template.
tickets.next_action: Share clean template, identify first failing row, and retry a small sample.

tickets.subject: Job opening is missing from active pipeline
tickets.customer_issue: Check job status, ownership, team permissions, and active filters.
tickets.next_action: Verify status and owner; explain where archived or closed jobs appear.

tickets.subject: Email sync stopped updating activity history
tickets.customer_issue: Check connection status, granted permissions, and sync scope.
tickets.next_action: Reconnect only through approved settings; collect last successful sync time.

tickets.subject: Weekly report total differs from pipeline view
tickets.customer_issue: Compare date range, record status, filters, and report definitions.
tickets.next_action: Reproduce with matching filters and explain the metric definition.

tickets.customer_issue: Check notification preferences, event details, and delivery channel.

tickets.customer_issue: Check role, team membership, record sharing, and workspace.
